summary: Tested 21 NEW backend endpoints/behaviors (heatmap, agent-categories, agents list/filter/detail, agent enquiries, property `lister` field, /compare, supplier reviews). 24/24 pytest assertions passed. Existing InfraLocal + Market tests were NOT re-run per instructions. TEST_ enquiries and reviews were cleaned up post-run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 689 lines and growing - should be split into modular routers (agents.py, market.py, heatmap.py, properties.py) for maintainability once past MVP.
GET /agents supports `q` + `area` combined via a manual `$and` list; works correctly but consider a shared search helper to keep the query builder DRY across /agents, /properties, /market/suppliers.
seed_data_creation: None. Test enquiries (name='TEST Buyer') and reviews (name='TEST User') were created for sup-06 and ag-01, then cleaned up via a teardown test that deletes TEST_-prefixed entries from agent_enquiries and supplier_reviews collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints verified against spec: heatmap returns {min,max,points[7]} with intensity min=0 max=1.0; 7 agent categories with agents_count>0; 13 agents with correct filter behavior (category/verified/featured/q/area); ag-01 detail includes category+recent_listings; enquiry POST validates mobile length (<10 -> 400) and agent existence (404); /properties/{id} includes deterministic `lister` object (Owner type for p-01 with agent_id=null, Broker type for p-03 with agent_id starting 'ag-', verified and rera_id present); /compare returns items in requested order, skips invalid ids silently, returns [] when all invalid; supplier reviews validate rating 1-5 and supplier existence.
